title: Bridge header
description: A see-through header that sticks to the top and blurs whatever scrolls behind it: wordmark left, a centred row of plain links with small chevrons and a thin divider, and an ink-outlined 'request a demo' button right. On phones the wordmark stacks over its tagline and a mono 'Menu' label with a two-line icon opens a full-width panel.
notes: sticks to the top (position: sticky), so it needs to sit directly in the page container
88px tall on phones, 70px from lg; a hero meant to run behind it pulls itself up by that much (bridge-hero's underHeader)
the phone menu is a native <details>; no JavaScript
name: bridge-header

props.name: brand
props.type: { name: string; href: string; icon?: ReactNode; tagline?: string | undefined; }
props.description: the wordmark: company name, small icon and parent-company tagline

props.name: action
props.description: the outlined button on the right

props.name: menuLabel
props.description: the word beside the phone menu icon, e.g. "Menu"
